recommendedTextbook.title: Cultural and Creative Arts for Junior Secondary Schools Book 2
recommendedTextbook.author: I. N. C. Aniekwe, S. O. Babalola
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Ancient Nigerian Art Traditions: Nok, Ife, Benin and Igbo-Ukwu
subtopics: Nok Culture (circa 500 BC - 200 AD): Terracotta heads, perforated eyes, triangular pupils, discovery by Bernard Fagg
Ife classical art: Naturalistic bronze and terracotta heads, cire perdue (lost wax) casting method
Benin royal art: Commemorative brass heads of Oba, Queen Mother Idia ivory mask, bronze palace plaques
objectives: Identify diagnostic physical features of ancient Nok terracotta sculptures
Explain the step-by-step metallurgical process of cire perdue lost-wax casting
Compare the naturalistic human realism of Ife sculptures with the ceremonial stylization of Benin court art

topics.topic: Nigerian Indigenous Crafts: Pottery, Weaving and Tie-and-Dye
subtopics: Pottery: Sourcing clay, preparation, pinch pot, coil building, slab method, firing in traditional bonfires
Textile crafts: Adire Eleko (starch resist), Adire Oniko (tied), Aso-Oke weaving on narrow looms
Calabash carving, leather tanning, and bead making in traditional Nigerian cultural hubs
objectives: Describe the pinch and coil techniques of modeling a traditional clay vessel
Create a completed tie-and-dye fabric pattern using wax or raffia resist techniques
Identify regional centers of traditional Nigerian textile weaving (Abeokuta, Iseyin, Akwete)

topics.topic: Nigerian Traditional Musical Instruments and Sound Classification
subtopics: Classification of instruments: Idiophones (struck objects: Shekere, Ekwe, Ogene, Agogo)
Membranophones (drums with skin heads: Gangan talking drum, Bata, Djembe)
Aerophones (wind instruments: Oja flute, Kakaki, Algaita) and Chordophones (string instruments: Goge, Ubo akwala)
objectives: Classify 10 traditional Nigerian musical instruments into the 4 organological families
Explain how the pitch of the Yoruba Gangan talking drum is altered by squeezing tension thongs
Demonstrate rhythmic accompaniment on an idiophone during a traditional cultural ensemble

topics.topic: Drama and Stage Production: Playwriting and Acting Essentials
subtopics: Playwriting elements: Theme, plot, dialogue, dramatic conflict, stage directions
Theatrical crew: Playwright, director, stage manager, set designer, costumier, lighting technician
Acting skills: Voice projection, character body language, facial expression, blocking and improvisation
objectives: Draft a 3-page dramatic dialogue script depicting communal peace and harmony
Identify responsibilities of the stage manager during live theatrical performances
Perform a 5-minute improvised character role demonstrating stage blocking and clear diction
